description: A spread of playing cards is laid out in a loose pyramid on the tabletop, with a deck held near the bottom left. The left hand steadily holds the deck as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches to the middle-right of the layout to pinch a single face-up card as a right-hand object, lifts it slightly, and slides it rightward and down onto the pile, then releases and smooths the nearby cards with a light touch.
